label: Area chart
desc: Smooth gradient area chart with axis ticks, a hover and keyboard crosshair with tooltip, and an optional stacked multi-series mode.
use: Traffic or growth over time on a dashboard or landing page.

label: Bar chart
desc: Vertical grouped or stacked bars with rounded tops, value labels on focus, and a horizontal option.
use: Comparing categories: sales by channel, tasks by status (dashboard, report).

label: Line chart
desc: Multi-series monotone line chart whose legend buttons toggle series, with a crosshair tooltip.
use: Trends of several metrics side by side on a dashboard.

label: Live line chart
desc: Streaming line that appends a point every second in a sliding window, with a pause button; it pauses off-screen and in hidden tabs.
use: Live status panels: requests per second, queue depth, active visitors.

label: Profit/loss line
desc: Line around a zero baseline with green fill above and red below, split by a clip path, and signed values in the tooltip.
use: Finance dashboards: monthly net result, margin, cash flow.

label: Composed chart
desc: Columns and a line in one chart, each on its own labelled y axis (revenue and conversion rate).
use: Two metrics with different units: revenue vs conversion, volume vs rate.

label: Scatter chart
desc: Scatter or bubble chart with group colours and marker shapes, nice axis ticks and a nearest-point tooltip.
use: Correlations and distributions: usage vs account size, price vs rating.

label: Candlestick chart
desc: OHLC candles (hollow when up, filled when down) with wicks, optional volume bars and an O/H/L/C tooltip.
use: Prices over time: markets, stock levels, any open/high/low/close series.
